semiconductor_relevance: High — Kayou is involved in the supply of advanced materials and equipment for power semiconductors, including SiC wafers and epitaxial deposition systems.
summary: Kayou, through its partnership with Huayang Co., Ltd., provides advanced materials and process equipment for power semiconductors, focusing on SiC wafer substrates and epitaxial deposition equipment. The company emphasizes quality and reliability in its offerings, aiming to support customer growth in the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.China: Kayou showcases products and capabilities in the Chinese market, leveraging local manufacturing and technology advancements.
